//: Presets of the poster-sections parameterized profile (capability 2, the same shape as doxa-simple-map's simple-map.instances.json). ONE profile, one preset per row: a poster type × a region (scope; 'all' = one section per region). The build emits a standalone page and embed snippet per preset at poster-sections/poster-sections/<id>/index.html and lists them in manifest.json. GENERATED by `bun run gen:poster-sections-presets` from each poster type's own scopes(), and check:poster-sections holds it to them: country posters = DX Life's /regions regions; a type joins once its type file is on the tree and its page can load it. 'configure' adds the panel of choices and Copy embed, a tool for making new presets.

instances.title: Country posters — North America & Non-Spanish Caribbean
